gloss: setting sail; departure (of a ship or aircraft)

definitions.gloss: setting sail; departure (of a ship or aircraft)
definitions.explanation: A ship or aircraft leaving on a voyage. The focus is on the start of the journey rather than on the act of leaving a particular harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出航|しゅっこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{出航|しゅっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The departure was postponed because of the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出航|しゅっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{一時間前|いちじかんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乗|の}って→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: We are scheduled to sail at nine in the morning, so please board an hour beforehand.

notes:
{出|しゅつ} (go out) + {航|こう} (voyage, navigation). Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出航|しゅっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set sail
- {出航|しゅっこう}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: departure time
- {出航|しゅっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見合|みあ}わせる→見合わせる：09450_miawaseru⟧: to hold off on sailing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出港|しゅっこう}→出港：11764_shukkou⟧: leaving port — a homophone that focuses on the ship leaving the harbor itself; often interchangeable in practice
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧: departure — the general word, used for any traveler or vehicle
- ⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧: entering port — the opposite movement
